sources.title: AI Classification in Machine Learning Explained
sources.snippet: I data classification, or AI classification, is the process of organizing data into predefined categories. The AI model is taught to recognize features and patterns in information, so it can identify them in any new data sets.

sources.title: Machine Learning: Classification Models | by Kirill Fuchs | Fuzz | Medium
sources.snippet: Given one or more inputs a classification model will try to predict the value of one or more outcomes. Outcomes are labels that can be applied to a dataset. For example, when filtering emails “spam” or “not spam” (also known as “ham”, < seriously, look it up if you don’t believe me), when looking at transaction data, “fraudulent”, or “authorized” · There are two approaches to machine learning: supervised and unsupervised. In a supervised model, a training dataset is fed into the classification algorithm.
